text:
maya: FYI support escalated tenant acme-payments-prod — customers seeing intermittent 504s to hosted inference (text-gen). Support attached a few req IDs and timestamps, error window ~14:20-14:35 UTC. paging @jon @priya

jon: On it. Looking at autoscaler and gateway traces now. Which model/route?

maya: Route: /v1/generate (model: redwood/gpt-medium). RPS spiked to ~120 for ~2m, then sustained 40-60 RPS. Gateway logs show a pattern: request queued -> "scale-up timeout" -> 504. Request IDs: req_9a1, req_9a2, req_9a3 (sent to support).

priya: Checking KEDA scaledobject: getting external metric scrape failures from our metrics exporter — logs show 401 on metrics endpoint for scaledobject "inference-pool-acme". ops-bot shows token refresh failing for the exporter around the same time.

li: Controller events: "FailedGetExternalMetric: failed to get external metrics: 401 Unauthorized". Also seeing several new pods stuck in ContainerCreating with events: "Back-off pulling image" followed by "FailedScheduling: 0/12 nodes available: Insufficient cpu" — two separate symptoms (auth to metrics + infra capacity).

carlos: Cloud console shows region us-west2 reached GPU quota limit at the time of the spike (GPU quota 12, used 12). New node pool scaleup requests were throttled by provider (API 429) and queued. That would cause K8s to delay scheduling new pods -> warmup backlog -> gateway timeouts.

priya: Logs from metrics-exporter (snippet):
```
2026-03-17T14:20:12Z ERROR token_refresh: token refresh failed: 401 Unauthorized
2026-03-17T14:20:13Z WARN scaler: returning empty metric set
```
That made KEDA think there's no work or fail to compute pending replicas.

jon: So two vectors: (1) KEDA external metric auth errors causing mis-scale, (2) cloud quota / node provisioning lag -> pod warmup backlog. Both combine to create scale-up lag and 504s.

maya: Immediate mitigation suggestions? Support asked for a hotfix to stop 504s ASAP.

carlos: Short-term: manually bump GKE GPU quota request (submit ticket) and manually create 2 spare nodes w/ GPU in the pool if provider allows (I can try). Also we can force HPA to scale replicas to 6 for this deployment as a stopgap (bypass ScaledObject).

priya: I added annotation to the ScaledObject to temporarily increase maxReplicaCount to 8 and triggered `kubectl scale deploy inference-acme --replicas=6` to force more pods while quota ticket is pending. Also changed KEDA scaler config in-cluster to reduce pollInterval from 30s->5s and cooldownPeriod 300->90 for this ScaledObject so it reacts faster for bursts.

jon: Rolling a small patch to the metrics-exporter: added retry on 401 and fallback to service-account token read. Will roll to staging then prod after quick smoke. Also we should avoid reducing pollInterval globally (control-plane load). Scoped to this ScaledObject only.

priya: Support routed traffic to fallback model redwood/gpt-small for the tenant at 14:28 UTC (lower memory / faster cold-start). Support confirmed observed percent of 504s dropped within ~40s after the manual scale. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: cloud-quota-ticket #7654 opened (provider ref 89012). Manual node creation attempted by carlos at 14:31 UTC; provider returned delayed provisioning (queued) but eventually allocated 2 GPU nodes at 14:44 UTC.

li: After node allocation pods started scheduling and readiness probes passed around 14:46 UTC. Gateway 504s cleared. Patch to metrics-exporter rolled to prod at 14:50 UTC. KEDA scaler auth errors stopped after exporter fix.

maya: Current status: customer traffic stabilized, no active 5xx for 20m. Keeping scaledobject pollInterval at 5s for this pool until tomorrow morning. Quota ticket still open but provider granted two extra nodes for now.

jon: Postmortem action items:
- alert: GPU quota exhaustion (new alert on provider quota usage)
- alert: KEDA external metric 4xx/5xx rate > 3 in 5m
- add prewarm option for big tenants (pre-allocated standing pool)
- docs: operator runbook for manual HPA override and fallback model routing
- improve metrics-exporter token refresh robustness (retry/backoff + early alert)

priya: I'll own the runbook and the KEDA metric alert. @carlos please follow up on quota ticket and confirm long-term capacity plan with infra.

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll update support and the customer. Closing thread once quota follow-up confirmed.

carlos: FYI provider confirmed temporary quota increase until EOD; will scope long-term commit tomorrow with infra.

maya: Marking resolved for now. Will open a postmortem doc in #postmortems tomorrow with timeline and remediation. :white_check_mark:
